about.title: About me
about.lead: I started with the foundation: computer assembly and maintenance, networks and a lot of development in my Technical Degree in Internet Computing.
about.body1: Since finishing the technical course, I have worked with HTML, CSS and JavaScript. The IT routine at BAAN, solving real users’ problems, taught me to design for the people who use things.
about.body2: I started with PHP and WordPress, and I still take freelance work: landing pages, websites and e-commerce stores. Not drag-and-drop WordPress: the work is done in code, in PHP.
about.body3: On the front-end, what I know best today is HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and Tailwind. I’m going deeper into TypeScript, where I’m already more confident, and starting to master Next.js. Alongside that, I’m in the 5th term of Software Engineering and building Caminu, a React Native app (see Projects).
